_note: Dungeon estimator data (row P0-7): counts and tokens ONLY — every dollar comes from canon.pricing by the selected backend's model (master §3.0-C). Tasks key the phase labels compose.py's pipeline emits (story / classes / db:<kind> / dialogue / spell_pool / narrative) plus classes:loadout for the per-archetype spell/ability batch calls (labelled <archetype>:spell|ability at run time).

_calibration.method: input_tokens / output_tokens per task = the per-phase actuals of a REAL anthropic run of this pipeline (2 rooms, 2 classes, 46 calls; generation_stats.json by_phase, token counts provider-reported) — measured beats guessed. The fake-mode measurement the row spec names (FakeLLMBackend, 1-map compose_pipeline, prompt chars / 4) is recorded beside it for comparison; fake prompts carry a near-empty cumulative context, so they under-read real inputs ~3x and real outputs ~4-10x (canned JSON vs prose).
_calibration.approximation: chars / 4 ≈ tokens for the fake-mode figures; the real-run figures are exact provider token counts. Inputs grow with the cumulative context (more rooms/entities → larger later prompts, capped by CanonConfig.context_limit_chars = 20000 chars ≈ 5000 tokens). The engine's actuals calibration (canon.estimator.actuals_by_task) is NOT wired for the dungeon: no dungeon path passes actuals_dir, and the pipeline's per-archetype loadout labels (<archetype>:spell|ability) and spell_pool:<pool> labels would need the same normalisation the estimator test's _task_of applies before they could key these tasks. Wiring it is the spend-ledger refine below (master §5), not this row.
_calibration.refine: master §5 open item — refine against the spend ledger after the first paid runs.

assets._note: counts-per-unit knobs mirroring canon.pipeline.phases.asset.AssetPhase (portraits per entity stub / class / room environment; the fixed music + SFX catalogs; one env track + one env ambience per unique environment — environments cycle through compose._ENVIRONMENTS) and the dialogue phase (4 tree variants per quest giver; parse_quest makes a room's first NPC the giver of every quest).
